entries.title: Taking over asks every other computer keeping a copy, even one it has only just reached
entries.body: When two computers that keep a copy reach each other at the same moment, a question one asks the other is answered over the connection they keep. Before, the question could fail as if the other computer were out of reach, so a takeover could start from an older copy or miss that another computer had already taken over.
entries.noPicture: This changes how two computers keeping a copy answer each other, not any view or control.
